test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

“Aren’t you afraid of travelling alone in a foreign country?” I asked Aditi.

options.text: I asked Aditi whether you are afraid of travelling alone in a foreign country.
I asked Aditi if you aren’t afraid of travelling alone in a foreign country.
I asked Aditi whether she was afraid of travelling alone in a foreign country.
I asked Aditi if she wasn’t afraid of travelling alone in a foreign country.

solution:
The correct answer is: **I asked Aditi if she wasn’t afraid of travelling alone in a foreign country.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is a direct speech and we need to convert it into an indirect speech.
 
• The given sentence is also an interrogative sentence.
 
• We follow these rules in Direct-Indirect speech for an interrogative sentence:
 
 
• A question mark should always be used at the end of an interrogative sentence in direct speech.
 
• To convert direct speech to indirect speech quotation marks should be replaced by a full stop.
 
• Asked remains the same if it is used in direct speech also.
 
• Interrogative sentence changes to assertive form [direct to indirect speech]
 
• The conjunction ‘that’ is not used to connect reporting and reported clauses instead of that, ‘if’ or ‘whether’ is used for the conversion to join the clauses.
 
• The helping verb 'aren't' changes to 'wasn't' in the indirect part.
 
 
 
• Example - *I asked her, “Will you give me a pen.” (Direct)*

* I asked her if she would give me a pen. (Indirect)*

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct indirect speech: *I asked Aditi if she wasn’t afraid of travelling alone in a foreign country.*
